custody_access_inventory.evidence_gap: Connector exposes project/org but no member listing or caller role; dashboard/browser read failed; no authenticated local CLI or management token was available or extracted.

network_pooler.why_unknown: Management-plane network restriction GET is not exposed by current connector/SQL; SQL cannot observe a pre-database network filter.
network_pooler.material_rule: If restrictions are applied, hosted Edge Functions cannot directly reach Postgres or the pooler; HTTPS APIs remain available but cannot implement the qualified custom LOGIN plus SET LOCAL ROLE contract.

historical_proof.fact: Custom-login Edge-to-native-SQL transactions were operational on 2026-09-03
historical_proof.limitation: Does not prove current network restrictions or present reachability.

jwks.interpretation: Asymmetric verification infrastructure exists; JWKS alone does not establish current/standby/previous lifecycle state.

selected_subject.authority_effect: Account/session evidence only; no custody, rights, privacy, admission or publication authority.

auth.session_validation: JWT session_id can be correlated to auth.sessions; sensitive EFTA actions must check live row existence because already-issued access tokens can remain valid until exp after sign-out.
auth.jwks_cache_risk: External verifier caches may extend trust after key rotation; live session/revocation checks remain mandatory.
